Gawarzec Górny  is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Czerwińsk nad Wisłą, within Płońsk County, Masovian Voivodeship, in east-central Poland. It lies approximately  north-west of Czerwińsk nad Wisłą,  south of Płońsk, and  north-west of Warsaw.
